assessment_summary: I inspected the running Compose stack in /workspace and exercised runtime behavior rather than checking files alone. Final method (make setup + docker compose up) is confirmed: all long-running services are Up (healthy) with zero restarts, createbuckets exited 0, and compose config validates. The server applied migrations 1-34, boots an OTP release (Bandit on 0.0.0.0:4000), and returns 200 on /health. The Matrix API answers (versions, login flows incl. m.login.sso/oidc, well-known client), serves an E2EE-disabled well-known, and correctly 401s unauthenticated register/sync/media on a fresh DB. The Admin/Bootstrap UI serves the wizard (302 to /admin/bootstrap, 200 page, working static assets, CSRF-enforced POST route). Backing services verified: Postgres 34 migrations + 49 tables, MinIO nebu-media bucket, healthy Dex with local password connector and dev users, and the /etc/hosts dex entry. Limitations/uncertainty: the interactive Bootstrap Wizard login (guide step 4) and browser-based Element SSO sign-in (step 5) were not completed, because they require a browser session; the server is intentionally fail-closed in this documented fresh-install state, so this does not indicate incompleteness. I also observed documentation drift (guide's removed nebu-admin client/secret and 'Nebu.Application started' log token vs. repo's nebu-gateway client and Bandit listener log), which is a doc mismatch rather than an installation defect. A Dex /dex/auth/local request returned 404 in a bare call, but Dex logs confirm the local password connector is enabled and healthy, so this is not disqualifying. Overall, objective evidence demonstrates a complete, operational installation per the guide.
